en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS` to change idle compaction's 200K-token minimum; `"idleCompaction": false` in settings.json turns it off. Both need v2.1.290 or later
zh: 新增 `CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS`，用于修改空闲上下文压缩的 200K token 下限；在 settings.json 中设置 `"idleCompaction": false` 可将其关闭。两者均需 v2.1.290 或更高版本
